theory.title: Habla de deportes y de lo que sabes hacer
theory.explanation: Usa can para decir que sabes o puedes hacer algo y can't para decir que no sabes o no puedes hacerlo. Después de can y can't, el verbo va en forma base, sin to y sin -s. Para preguntar, coloca Can al principio: Can you swim? Puedes añadir well o very well para describir cómo haces una actividad.
theory.tip: No digas “I can to swim” ni “She cans swim”. La forma correcta es “I can swim” y “She can swim”.

patterns.label: Answer yes
examples: Can you swim? Yes, I can.

patterns.label: Answer no
examples: Can you ski? No, I can't.

patterns.label: Use can with he and she

content.passage: My name is Asha and I am twelve years old. I love sport and I am in the school sports club. I can play basketball and tennis. I can run very fast, but I can't swim well. My brother Ben can swim and ride a bike. He can't play tennis, but he can play football. Our friend Sara can dance and skate. She can't ski at all. On Friday, we have a sports lesson at school. We can try new activities together.

items.prompt: Ask about playing tennis. (Pregunta si alguien sabe jugar al tenis.)

content.audioTranscript: Hello, Ben. Can you play basketball? Yes, I can. Can you swim too? No, I can't swim, but I can ride a bike. What about tennis? I can play tennis with my sister. Can your sister run fast? Yes, she can. She can dance very well, but she can't play football. We can skate together on Saturday, but we can't ski.
